author: Murphh
body:
As requested, I've updated the walls map, Camp Creeper.

Removed:
* gapple from treehouse
* strength items (blaze powder, blaze rod, netherwart)
* some potions (especially potions orange area)
* mid diamond pickaxe on top (replaced with 2 diamonds)
* 61 diamonds per quad

Added per quad:
* 52 iron
* 16 emeralds
* some more chain and gold gear (7 items)

Hopefully, the map will play better and not be "as op".
If more changes are needed, please let me know.
